question: A motorist travels a total distance of 30 km in 50 minutes. He drives at a speed of x km/hr for the first 11 minutes, then at 2x km/hr for the next 25 minutes, and finally at x km/hr for the remaining part of the journey. Find the value of x .
solution:
**Given:**

Total distance = 30

Total time = 50 minutes

Time₁ = 11 minutes

Time₂ = 25 minutes

Time₃ = 50 - 11 - 25 = 14 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Time (in hours) = minutes ÷ 60

**Calculation:**

⇒ Distance₁ = x × (11 ÷ 60)

⇒ Distance₂ = 2x × (25 ÷ 60)

⇒ Distance₃ = x × (14 ÷ 60)

⇒ Total distance = 30

⇒ x(11 ÷ 60) + 2x(25 ÷ 60) + x(14 ÷ 60) = 30

⇒ x/60 (11 + 50 + 14) = 30

⇒ x/60 × 75 = 30

⇒ 75x = 30 × 60

⇒ 75x = 1800

⇒ x = 1800 ÷ 75

⇒ x = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24.**
